_comment: Apify Store actors per job board. input: the actor's INPUT, with {query} {location} {country} {limit} placeholders ({limit} becomes a number; a placeholder with no value drops its key). defaults fill placeholders the CLI flags leave empty. fields: candidate output paths per contract field, first non-empty wins. Input/output names differ per actor and change over time: confirm against the actor's Input and Output tabs on apify.com, then run one search with -n 3 before relying on a board.

indeed._verified: Checked 2026-11-16. Input schema: position, country (enum incl. IN, DE, LU), location, maxItemsPerSearch, parseCompanyDetails, saveOnlyUniqueItems. Pricing: pay-per-event, $0.006 per listing on the free tier (20 listings = $0.12). Output confirmed by a 3-listing run (engineering manager, IN, Bengaluru): positionName, company, location, url (in.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=), id, postingDateParsed (ISO; postedAt was null), salary (often null), jobType (array), isExpired, externalApplyLink, description, descriptionHTML.

naukri._disabled_reason: naukri.com's robots.txt disallows Claude user agents (search-queries.md). Running a third-party scraper there routes around a site that said no, which this workspace's robots rule (09-web-research.md) does not do. Enable only as your own informed choice.

glassdoor._cost: $0.0004 per job on the free tier, full description included (20 jobs = $0.008). 3,700 users, 4.4 stars.
glassdoor._verified: Verified by a 3-listing run on 2026-11-16 (engineering manager, Bengaluru): 3 rows, snake_case fields. Keyword search was loose (2 of 3 were Product Manager roles; the seniority filter let an Associate PM through), so matchTitle is set to strict: the title must contain every word of the term. job_url is a per-search tracking link, so url uses the stable job_seo_url. Salary is omitted because Glassdoor's figures are its own estimates (job_salary.estimated: true). job_posted_date can be a refresh date (one row: posted 2026-11-11, age 157 days). job_apply_url is also a Glassdoor tracking link, not the employer's posting, so applyUrl is left unmapped.

foundit._cost: $0.006 per job plus $0.005 per run (20 jobs = $0.125). experienceMinYears 8 drops junior roles server-side; postedWithinDays is server-side, so stale postings are not billed.
foundit._verified: Verified by a 3-listing run on 2026-11-16 (engineering manager, Bengaluru): 3 strong matches (IDFC EM 10-18 yrs, Nium Senior EM SRE, Apple Senior Software EM). All 3 were syndicated: applyUrl often points to LinkedIn, so scrape_state's company+title dedup catches overlap with linkedin-search. salary was null on all rows.

instahyre._cost: $0.00105 per job plus $0.0001 per detail (20 jobs = $0.023). Agency-posted jobs excluded.
instahyre._verified: Verified by a 3-listing run on 2026-11-16 (engineering manager, Bengaluru): 2 rows from 10 pages of the backend-development feed (ZoomInfo Senior EM Integration; Flipkart Senior EM Payments). No posting-date field, so date is always null and --jobage cannot filter it. Both rows came back isAgencyPosted: true despite excludeAgencyPosted.

remote._cost: $0.002 per unique job (20 jobs = $0.04), deduplicated across RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely, Remotive, Himalayas, Jobicy and Relomote.
remote._verified: Verified by a 3-listing run on 2026-11-16 (engineering manager, Bengaluru): 1 row (Smartsheet Manager, Engineering via WeWorkRemotely, applicantCountries Anywhere). Low yield for EM terms; title text can say a narrower region than applicantCountries, so read the posting. Arbeitnow is left out (arbeitnow-search CLI covers it); --location is ignored.

cutshort._status: robots.txt allows Claude (checked 2026-11-16). Input fields taken from the Store listing only; full schema not yet checked. Output field names are not confirmed (the actor publishes no output schema): run one search with -n 3, fix 'fields' if PARSE_FAILED, then set enabled to true.
cutshort._cost: $0.05 per run plus $0.0018 per job (20 jobs = $0.086); the start fee makes small runs expensive. The cheaper getascraper/cutshort-scraper searches by skill tags only, which does not fit role-title terms.

stepstone._cost: $0.0007 per job plus $0.004 per run (20 jobs = $0.018). Many listings require German (Language Gate).
